must_identify.item: Pods are in ImagePullBackOff / ErrImagePull because the tag nginx:1.27-alpne does not exist
must_identify.evidence: The root cause is confirmed: the frontend Deployment's revision 2 spec references container image `nginx:1.27-alpne`, a typo missing the "i" in "alpine" [5, 8]. Kubelet repeatedly failed to resolve this reference, logging "docker.io/library/nginx:1.27-alpne: not found" against pod `frontend-7b6c998456-phg6r` [7].

must_identify.item: The old pods are still serving (rollout stuck, not an outage)
must_identify.evidence: There was no user-facing outage: Kubernetes' RollingUpdate strategy (maxUnavailable 25%) correctly preserved the two healthy old pods, keeping the Deployment Available [10].

notes: The RCA never explicitly recommends a remediation. It only notes that the corrected tag nginx:1.27-alpine is pullable, which implies but does not state the fix. The RCA also describes `rollout history` as a 'mutating' operation blocked by policy, but it is read-only, so a reviewer may want to check the tool/policy log.
